Title: Webhook GET 401 Unauthorized
RootCause: Authentication middleware intercepted GET monitoring probes before reaching endpoint
RemediationApplied: Exempted GET probe from token check while preserving strict HMAC validation on POST

Title: Spurious Sandbox Downgrade on Vercel
RootCause: VERCEL_URL contains unique hash instead of astroverse-eta.vercel.app causing isVercelPreview=true
RemediationApplied: Replaced fragile URL substring check with authoritative production host detection and secret key prefix inference

Title: Gateway Environment Mismatch
RootCause: Live production secret key (cfsk_ma_prod_) paired with sandbox mode triggered ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH 503
RemediationApplied: Implemented key-driven environment auto-alignment where cfsk_ma_prod_ strictly locks mode to production

Title: Recharge Modal Configuration Mismatch
RootCause: Frontend received 503 PAYMENTS_NOT_CONFIGURED from create-order and displayed failure modal
RemediationApplied: Harmonized cashfree.ts environment resolution and synchronized FeatureFlag in Supabase DB
RegressionTest: Live CDP Browser Verification (0 Console Errors)

Title: Cashfree Order Customer Phone Formatting
RootCause: Non-standard phone inputs failed Cashfree v6 regex validation
RemediationApplied: Added inline sanitization stripping country codes and whitespace to exactly 10 digits with 9999999999 fallback

Title: Supabase FeatureFlag Out of Sync
RootCause: PostgreSQL CASHFREE_GATEWAY_CONFIG row was missing or out of sync with production keys
RemediationApplied: Directly upserted JSON config into Supabase FeatureFlag table via service role REST API

Title: Serverless In-Memory State Loss
RootCause: Worker recycling caused ephemeral in-memory order map to lose pending orders
RemediationApplied: Implemented findPaymentOrderByIdAsync fallback rehydrating order directly from PostgreSQL

Title: Deprecated Direct Balance Recharge
RootCause: Legacy /api/wallet/recharge allowed potential unverified client credits
RemediationApplied: Replaced endpoint with HTTP 400 DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT directing callers to authenticated order-and-verify flow

Title: Admin Order Recovery Missing Auth
RootCause: Manual recovery endpoint lacked strict admin role check

Title: Cross-User Order ID Verification Enumeration
RootCause: Any authenticated user could query status of another user's orderId
RemediationApplied: Enforced strict user ownership check (auth.uid === order.userId) returning HTTP 403
